items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to go down

items.quote: thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves
items.claim: The Israelite people corrupted themselves after being brought out of Egypt

items.quote: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them
items.claim: The people turned aside quickly from the way God commanded them

items.quote: they have made them a molten calf
items.claim: The people made a molten calf

items.quote: have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto
items.claim: The people worshipped the molten calf and made sacrifices to it

items.quote: These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt
items.claim: The people claimed the calf was their god that brought them up from Egypt
